gp.note: the library's GP (Library._fit_inputs settings); N-104's folds, from its job cache

gp_paper.note: sklearn GaussianProcessRegressor, PACOSYT's kernel 0.1**2 * RationalQuadratic(1e-8, alpha 1e-8) + 1**2 * RBF(5), alpha 1e-8, no restarts, inputs standardized, target standardized (normalize_y); untuned

krr.note: sklearn KernelRidge(kernel='rbf') on the centred target, gamma = g / d, alpha; inner 3-fold CV

knn.note: sklearn KNeighborsRegressor(weights='distance'); inner 3-fold CV (1 neighbour is the paper's NN)
